newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Monark Stiga buys Italy's Bianchi bicycles.
newsitem.headline: Monark Stiga buys Italy's Bianchi bicycles.

text.p: Swedish bicycle company Monark Stiga AB said on Monday it had signed an agreement with Italy's Piaggio group regarding the acquisition of Italian bicycle company F.I.V. Edoardo Bianchi.
Monark Stiga said in a statement that Piaggio would become a shareholder in Monark Stiga.
"Through the acquisition, Monark Stiga will further strengthen its position as the major player on the European bicycle market," the Swedish company said in a statement.
Monark Stiga's turnover increases by 430 million crowns to more than 3.9 billion crowns through the purchase, it said.
